messages:
Maya: Quick idea — can we add a tiny hooklet system to deploy-bot so teams can opt into pre/post deploy smoke checks that can auto-rollback if a critical check fails? keeps rollbacks predictable and reduces manual churn.
Devon: +1. keep it minimal and opt-in. flags like --hooks=pre:smoke,post:canary and a simple on-fail policy. no heavyweight tests here, just fast health checks. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay: Important: change-window behavior. if a hook triggers a rollback during a scheduled change window we should NOT page SRE by default — just annotate release notes and ping the release owner. paging should be configurable.
Olivia: Agree. Also we should include a couple of templates (quick-smoke, full-canary-check, db-migrate-sanity) so teams don't invent ad-hoc scripts. makes audits + release notes easier.
Maya: Sketch of a command idea: `/deploy start --image=service:v2 --hooks=pre:quick-smoke --on-fail=auto-rollback --notify=release-owner`
Devon: Example hook config (YAML template):
---
hooks:
  - name: quick-smoke
    when: pre
    cmd: ./scripts/quick_smoke.sh
    timeout: 30s
    failure_policy: 
      action: rollback
      threshold: error_rate>0.05
      notify: [release-owner, #eng-oncall]
  - name: canary-check
    when: post
    cmd: ./scripts/canary_healthcheck.sh
    timeout: 120s
    failure_policy:
      action: pause-rollout
      threshold: latency_p90>800ms
      notify: [release-owner]
---
Olivia: We should add a lightweight templating helper in the CLI: `deploy hook init quick-smoke` that drops the YAML in the repo and a sample smoke script. good for onboarding.
Sanjay: Edge cases: a) hooks must run in isolated env (no secrets leaked), b) must be idempotent, c) we need metrics emitted so Console can show hook pass/fail rates in rollout timeline.
Maya: UX question — where do we show hook results? prefer per-route release timeline + token in release notes (e.g., Hook: quick-smoke = PASS). also archive the hook output (first 48h) for postmortem.
DeployBot: acknowledged: I can emit a `hook-result` event and annotate the rollout. Example event: `deploy:hook:result service:v2 quick-smoke PASS`
Devon: Implementation plan (tiny RFC in PR): 1) CLI flags + template generator 2) backend: hook runner service (short-lived containers) 3) deploy-bot glue to run hooks pre/post and evaluate policies 4) Console: show hook timeline + small artifact storage (48h).
Olivia: I'll draft templates tonight and drop a PR against infra/deploy-templates. Maya — can you add a short blurb for release notes auto-annotation?
Maya: yep, will add blurb and a sample annotation format. Example: `hooks: [{name: quick-smoke, outcome: PASS, artifact: /artifacts/....}]`
Sanjay: One more: make the rollback command idempotent and fast. maybe a `--fast-rollback` path that skips some checks if triggered by hook to meet SLA. discuss in PR.
Devon: Looks good. I'll open the RFC and assign owners. tagging @release-sherpa for visibility. :eyes:
